answer: A worker's past is a vine: every claim must trace its inputs back along the public trellis to one human-signed request. A harbor warden walks that vine to its root within an hour, checking each link names a real parent job. A vine that loops, ends nowhere, or copies another root is a cut vine: claim void, barred a week. Five cents and one real job buy an honest worker its vine; 1,000 fakes must grow 1,000 vines with real human roots and pay $50.
